QuestInfo.name: Isabella's Search
QuestInfo.1: Ken in Year 2216: Ruined City mentioned receiving an SOS signal from the #beast area#k. The signaler is #bprobably a female in her teens#k, so you should head out to find her.
QuestInfo.2: Ken, whom you met in the ruins of the city in year 2216, requested that you investigate the eastern regions where he received a rescue signal. You found a teenage female who appeared to be passed out from exhaustion. Fortunately, she was conscious when you talked to her.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 549,407
Can proceed to What was That I Saw? quest
Can proceed to Starting Rescue Operations quest
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p2082017# has more favors to ask. Go see what's up.

0.0: I'm glad you came. I received a request for help, but I can't detect the exact location. We have to dispatch a search party, and I need you to lead it.

yes.0: Okay. The SOS signal is coming from the #beast#k, and the distressed person is probably #ba female in her teens#k. Search the east side to see if there's anyone matching that description and let me know ASAP.

no.0: Somebody's life depends on this. We don't have time to sit and wait around!

1.0: Help! Help me! Are you here to rescue me?

yes.0: Thank you. I've drained all my energy, but I'm hanging in there. I didn't think anyone would ever get here. I was so scared.

npc.0: Please search the eastern regions and let me know as soon as you find someone.
